statement: Under the U(q)-torsor identification of a chamber-star support, the induced theta graph is Cay(U(q), union_i(H_i\{1})) for the four positive-root subgroups H_i.
synthesis: Pass5119 half-regularity on a minimum word is exactly the root-direction Cayley degree; Pass5129 active charts are the same root-subgroup cosets viewed as cliques.
boundary: The Cayley identification is for the chamber-star minimum family, not arbitrary codeword supports.
